cases.md:
**What I need to start: only your picks.** No accounts, keys or server access: every fix is backend code, built and tested here, pushed to `origin` for CI. You release it to OVH as usual.

| Finding | What the fix does |
|---|---|
| `mod-fail-open` | With `REQUIRE_SAFETY_CONTROLS=1` in the production compose file, the API refuses to start unless AWS, AssemblyAI and `ADMIN_TOKEN` are set; `/healthz` reports each control. The next release then can't start without those keys on the server, by design. |
| `ban-control` | Accounts get a status: active, suspended or banned. A kill for explicit content suspends the streamer until an admin lifts it; resolving a report can ban. Suspended accounts get 403 on user routes. |
| `reports-abuse` | Only people in a session (or its job) can report it, at most 5 times an hour. An admin can close a hold as invalid, so erasure proceeds. |
| `bypass-guard` | Production can't run the unchecked sign-in mode (see that item). |

Defaults I'd use unless you say otherwise: suspension stays until an admin lifts it; report limit 5 per hour. Each fix is one reviewable commit with its tests.
